messages:
sam: noticing multiple reports about slow initial dashboard load this morning. looks like charts take ~2.5-4s to become interactive for some users. saw spikes from EU and a handful in us-west. :frowning:

alex: thanks — saw alerts too. heap snapshots show big parse time in vendor.js and repeated dynamic imports for `locale-en-US` chunk. waterfall shows duplicate GETs returning 200.

maria: odd. we didn't touch chunking code. any recent changes to routing or prefetch policies?

riley: we rolled a routing policy tweak in yesterday's release: increased `prefetch.quota_ms` to 1500 to allow background prefetching to run longer, thinking that'd improve cold-start charts. config diff: `prefetch.quota_ms: 1500 (was 600)`.

alex: that aligns. with a longer prefetch window, client affinity mapping keeps stale entry and re-triggers prefetches during route transitions. the same split gets requested twice. that extra vendor/locales parse spikes main thread right when chart hydration kicks in.

maria: confirmed in canary VMs: disable prefetch.quota (set 0) and the duplicate fetch stops. charts are buttery again.

ci-bot: deploy: canary promoted r-2025-02-11-09 -> app-console (started 2025-02-11T08:47Z).

sam: can we hotfix quick? two small options: 1) dedupe dynamic import promises in split-loader; 2) shorten prefetch.quota_ms back to 600. prefer 1 for correctness.

riley: i'll open a tiny PR to reuse in-flight promises and mark affinity entries with last-request-id. patch: `if (inFlight[split]) return inFlight[split]` and `affinity.touch(id)` to avoid double enqueue.

maria: add a guard around telemetry sampler registration too. today we saw two samplers stringify the same payload at once. `if (sampler._registered) return` plus debounce flush to 250ms.

alex: can we also avoid synchronous JSON.stringify on main thread? move serialization to a worker or use structuredClone + postMessage to worker to stringify there. that'd mitigate heavy parses if duplication slips through.

sam: agree — short term: roll prefetch.quota_ms back to 600 and merge fetch-dedupe patch. longer term: telemetry worker + tests. I'll roll canary back now if y'all want to validate.

riley: pushing PR 5831 for fetch-dedupe. small unit tests included. link: https://internal.github/repo/pr/5831

maria: pushing PR 5832 for sampler-guard + debounce. link: https://internal.github/repo/pr/5832

ci-bot: rollback triggered for app-console to r-2025-02-10-22 at 2025-02-11T09:12Z by sam.
